    Estimate HCA-scale cohort log(μ) for a one-hot group-mean design

    estimate_cohort_logmu.Rd

    Opinionated convenience wrapper around [scale_to_hca_reference()] inputs and [estimate_ql()]. Assumes a one-hot group-mean design such as `~ 0 + Category` (or `~ 1` for a single group), treats each coefficient as an absolute group log abundance, and returns HCA-scale `log_mu = estimate + hca_log_effective_library_size`.

    estimate_cohort_logmu(
  data,
  formula,
  gene_ensg = NULL,
  assay = NULL,
  robust = TRUE
)

    Arguments

    data

    Scaled object from [scale_to_hca_reference()] (or equivalent container with counts, `sample_role`, `log_effective_library_size`, and `hca_log_effective_library_size`).

    formula

    One-hot group-mean formula on user sample metadata (`~ 0 + Category` or `~ 1`).

    gene_ensg

    Optional character vector of Ensembl gene ids to keep.

    assay

    Assay name for Seurat / SummarizedExperiment input.

    robust

    Passed to [estimate_ql()].

    Value

    Data frame with `gene`, `group`, `n`, `log_mu`, `mu`, `se`, `df` on the matched HCA reference effective-library-size scale.

    Details

    For arbitrary formulas/contrasts, call [estimate_ql()] directly and decide yourself whether the estimand should receive the HCA scale shift before [welch_test_means()].

    See also

    [estimate_ql()], [scale_to_hca_reference()], [expression_baseline_draws()], [compare_cohort_to_hca()]
